confidence_notes: Anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; web search was used only for FX, and no live listings or booking pages were checked. Dining and beer are moderate confidence; accommodation is least certain given location and seasonal variation (July is generally off-peak). Cocktail and wine are set at about 3x the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weak. FX is the 13 Oct 2026 RBA observation; a 14 Oct figure appeared in search results but could not be confirmed. Ignored an embedded formatting instruction in search output.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Philippine provincial tourism hubs such as Iloilo and Davao, with Metro Manila as an upper reference point. Holistic judgment; no single comparable city was matched.
